fixture_precision: Uses documented default optimizer gradient tolerance1e-7. Independent numerical reference acceptance tolerances are unchanged; returned fits additionally require an independent SciPy central-difference average-NLL score <=2e-7.

independent_reference.optimizer_message: Desired error not necessarily achieved due to precision loss.

method.tail: Q(a,x)=Gamma(a,x)/Gamma(a), computed by mpmath.gammainc(a,x,inf) directly at80dps. Never1-rounded lower CDF.
method.quantile: Find root logQ(a,q)=log1p(-p), using exact binary-float input probability, starting bracket(.3,.4).
method.binary_inputs: mp.mpf(float) retains the exact f64 input, rather than treating decimal1e-14 as the exact complement.
method.cross_check: SciPy gammaincc, gamma.pdf/ppf and independent upper-tail quadrature atx=.1. SciPy lower gammainc is shown only as supplemental output, not the tail oracle.

assertion_count_method: Scalar numerical comparisons plus explicit regression contract predicates. Nonfinite JSON is independently rejected for every decoded result.
